page_summary:
This anthology draws from Dick's prolific short fiction output, primarily written in the 1950s and early 1960s, to present a curated selection of his shorter works. The edition's front matter lists his full novel bibliography spanning from Solar Lottery through The Transmigration of Timothy Archer, dating this edition's publication to after 1982 and confirming its place among the wave of posthumous anthologies that helped cement Dick's reputation as a major American writer beyond his novels alone.

**Why it matters.** Dick was one of the most prolific short story writers in science fiction, producing over 120 stories, many later adapted for film and television; anthologies like this one made that vast, scattered body of magazine fiction newly accessible to readers encountering Dick primarily through his novels and their adaptations.
